curfew.name: Night Curfew
curfew.desc: The Watch clears the streets after dark. Unrest −10, restless cleared faster; happiness −4.
curfew.flavor: "Halt. Are you living? Then go home."

draughts.name: Free Healing Draughts
draughts.desc: Moonwort draughts for every household. Health +12; costs 0.3 crowns per resident per day.
draughts.flavor: The alchemists grumble about the price. The children stop coughing.

rites.name: Rite Subsidy
rites.desc: The city pays the sextons. Boneyards and Ossuaries quiet 50% more dead. 25 crowns/day per deathcare building.
rites.flavor: Salt on the lips, a coin on the eyes, and now a second coin for Hollis.

herbgardens.name: Herb Garden Edict
herbgardens.desc: Every Craft yard must keep a glimherb bed. Goods production +25%, miasma +30%.
herbgardens.flavor: The alchemist's breath grows sweeter and thicker.

lanternlevy.name: Lantern Levy
lanternlevy.desc: Markets pay for the street lanterns. Market tithe +20%, market happiness −6.
lanternlevy.flavor: "It Moves," says the guild seal. "It Pays," says the Warden-Reeve.

imports.name: Import Goods
imports.desc: The Trade Depot buys goods for markets with empty shelves at twice the export price. Needs a Trade Depot.
imports.flavor: Potions from Vell-on-Sable, sold at Vell-on-Sable prices.

scholars.name: Scholars' Stipend
scholars.desc: Free schooling for every child of the city. Educated share grows 50% faster. 0.2 crowns per resident per day.
scholars.flavor: The girl who reads leystone like a book now has forty classmates.
